title.narrative: Grenada - Caribbean Regional Air Transport Connectivity

description.narrative: The Project Development Objectives (PDO) are to (i) improve operational safety and navigation efficiency of air transportation, (ii) increase the climate and disaster resilience of MBIA and (iii) strengthen Grenada's capacity in civil aviation and airport management

The objectives of the Caribbean Air Transport Connectivity Project for Grenada are to (i) improve operational safety and navigation efficiency of air transportation, (ii) increase the climate and disaster resilience of Maurice Bishop International Airport (MBIA) and (iii) strengthen Grenada's capacity in civil aviation and airport management. The Project has four components. 1. Operational Safety and Resilience Enhancement component will improve MBIA operational safety and resilience and support Grenada's efforts to comply with International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO's) Standards and Recommended Practices (SARP) and abide by the Port of Spain (POS) Declaration. 2. Technical Assistance and Capacity Building component will strengthen the institutional capacity of Grenada Airports Authority (GAA) and Civil Aviation Division through a combination of regional and Grenada-specific technical assistance and capacity building activities with a focus on enhancing aircraft operational safety, air transport sector regulatory oversight, airport management capability, climate/disaster resilience, and gender diversity in the workplace. 3. Project Management component will be implemented by the Ministry of Infrastructure Development, Public Utilities, Energy, Transportation and Implementation (MOIID) with close coordination and participation from line agencies, including the Ministry of Tourism and Civil Aviation (MOTCA), and the GAA responsible for MBIA. 4. Contingent Emergency Response component will provide immediate response to an eligible emergency.

condition.narrative: No later than thirty (30) days after the Effective Date, the Recipient, through MOIID shall (a) designate a Project manager tomanage the implementation of the Project, including coordination and collaboration among MOIID, MOF, MOTCA, GAA, the Civil AviationDivision, and ECCAA, with qualifications, terms of reference, and under terms and conditions acceptable to the Association and asfurther described in the Operational Manual; and (b) designate an environmental and social specialist with qualifications, termsof reference, and under terms and conditions acceptable to the Association and as further described in the Operational Manual.(Schedule 2, Section I.A.2 of the FA)

No later than thirty (30) days after the Effective Date, the Recipient, through MOIID shall enter into an implementation agreementwith GAA, under terms and conditions acceptable to the Association (“Implementation Agreement”), which shall include, inter alia,(a) the roles and responsibilities of GAA with regard to the implementation of the Project; and (b) the obligation of GAA to complywith the requirements applicable to the Project in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement. (Schedule 2, Section I.A.5 ofthe FA)
The Recipient shall carry out the Project in accordance with the implementation arrangements set forth in Section I, Schedule 2 ofthe Financing Agreement (FA).

The Recipient shall coordinate with the Eastern Caribbean Civil Aviation Authority (ECCAA) with respect to Project activitiesrelated to capacity building on air transport regulation and oversight. (Schedule 2, Section I.A.3 of the FA)

The Recipient shall prepare and furnish to the Association for its review and approval, a Contingency Emergency Response Manual(“CER Manual”) which shall set forth detailed implementation arrangements for the Emergency Response Part of the Project. (Schedule2, Section I.D.1 of the FA)

The Recipient shall undertake no activities under the Emergency Response Part of the Project unless: (a) the Recipient hasdetermined that an Eligible Crisis or Emergency has occurred, has furnished to the Association a request to include said activitiesand the Association has agreed; and (b) the Recipient has ensured the preparation and disclosure of all environmental and socialinstruments as may be required for said activities, the Association has approved all said instruments, and the Recipient hasensured the implementation of any actions which are required to be taken under said instruments. (Schedule 2, Section I.D.3 of theFA)

The Recipient shall, throughout the implementation of the Emergency Response Part of the Project, maintain the institutionalstructures and arrangements established in accordance with the CER Manual, with adequate staff and resources satisfactory to theAssociation. (Schedule 2, Section I.D.2 of the FA)

The Recipient, through the MOIID, shall operate and maintain throughout Project implementation: (a) a Project Oversight Committeeto monitor Project implementation and provide guidance on policy and institutional matters, with a composition and terms ofreference satisfactory to the Association, as further described in the Operational Manual; and (b) a Technical Advisory Committeeto assist with the technical oversight of the Project, with a composition and terms of reference satisfactory to the Association,as further described in the Operational Manual. (Schedule 2, Section I.A.4 of the FA)

title.narrative: Modernization of air navigation systems and oversight

comment.narrative:
Indicator measures the (a) installation of an Instrument Landing System (ILS) for Runway 10, (b) deployment of Automatic Dependent Surveillance - Broadcast (ADS-B), (c) installation of a Precision Approach Path Indicator (PAPI) for Runway 28, (d) provision of Automatic Terminal Information Service (ATIS).
None of the planned air navigation systems were installed/commissioned. While (c) PAPI for Runway 28 was procured by the GoG (with financing from another project), the system has yet to be installed and commissioned.

title.narrative: Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR) of Grenada Airport Authority (previous year)

comment.narrative:
DSCR is a measurement of the cash flow available to pay current debt obligations. The ratio states net operating income as a multiple of debt obligations due within one year, including interest, principal, sinking-fund and lease payments.
GAA reported that their DSCR was 2.207 for the fiscal year ending December 2024. For 2025, the year-to-date period ending in May reports a DSCR of 1.339.
